prompts.title: Close-up Portrait of a Man with Leaf Shadows
prompts.prompt:
Create a cinematic close-up portrait of a stylish man with natural hair, wearing round vintage gold-wire sunglasses with dark brown tinted lenses. He is wearing a black crew-neck T-shirt. His head is slightly tilted downward and subtly turned to the left side, chin naturally lowered, with his gaze directed slightly downward through the sunglasses. Calm, confident, introspective expression with relaxed lips.
Warm golden sunlight filtering through dense green leaves creates natural dappled leaf shadows across his face. Soft blurred green foliage fills the lower foreground and background, with some leaves partially obscuring the lower frame and creating depth. Warm highlights on the skin and hair, rich earthy brown and deep green tones, moody luxury fashion editorial aesthetic.
Composition: extremely tight close-up, face dominating the frame, cantered composition, intimate perspective, natural foreground foliage framing the portrait. Aspect ratio 4:5.
Camera: eye-level to slightly elevated camera angle, 85mm portrait lens, f/1.8 aperture, very shallow depth of field, sharp focus on facial features and sunglasses, creamy natural bokeh, cinematic depth, realistic skin pores and hair detail.
Lighting: warm late-afternoon natural sunlight, soft directional sunlight from the side, high-quality golden-hour illumination, intricate organic leaf-shadow patterns, gentle highlights and deep natural shadows, no artificial studio look.
Style: photorealistic, cinematic color grading, premium fashion photography, rich contrast, ultra-detailed skin texture, visible pores, atmospheric, 8k ultra-high details.
Negative prompt: no eye contact, distorted face, deformed sunglasses, unnatural skin, plastic skin, flat lighting, low resolution, blurry face, bad anatomy.

prompts.title: Sunstrip
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded photo strictly only for subject’s facial identity reference. Preserve the person’s natural face shape, facial proportions, skin tone, eyes, eyebrows, nose, lips, facial hair if present, and overall likeness. Do not beautify, reshape, masculinize, feminize, or change the person’s identity.

Create an ultra-realistic cinematic fine-art portrait in a vertical 4:5 composition.

Show the subject in a tight head-and-neck portrait, nearly front-facing with only a subtle three-quarter turn toward camera-left. Keep the head still and natural, with the gaze directed slightly past the camera toward camera-left. The expression is calm, serious, introspective, and intense, with relaxed facial muscles and closed lips—never smiling or exaggerated.

Hair should appear naturally textured, with realistic individual strands and a few loose strands falling across the forehead. Preserve the subject’s natural hair color from the uploaded photo.

Lighting is the main visual feature: render the portrait almost entirely in deep monochrome black, charcoal, and muted cool gray tones. A single narrow horizontal strip of warm golden-amber light passes cleanly across both eyes, the bridge of the nose, and the upper cheeks, as though direct sunlight is entering through a very narrow window slit. The light band must have crisp, clearly defined top and bottom edges, remain narrow, and create a strong contrast against the surrounding darkness.

The golden light should reveal detailed eyelashes, eye reflections, eyebrow texture, pores, and subtle cheek texture, but it must not make the eyes look supernatural or change their natural iris color. Keep all warmth strictly inside this narrow light strip; the rest of the face, hair, neck, clothing, and background should remain heavily desaturated and shadowy.

Frame the face large in the composition, with the eyes placed near the upper third. Let the hair occupy the upper frame naturally, while the jaw, neck, and shoulders gradually disappear into rich black shadow. The subject wears a plain black collared shirt or dark jacket that blends softly into the darkness.

Background: pure seamless black with no visible objects, texture, light sources, or environmental detail.

Rendering quality: extremely realistic skin pores, subtle natural imperfections, detailed facial hair or stubble where applicable, sharp eyelashes, realistic hair strands, controlled micro-contrast, rich blacks, deep shadow retention, and premium editorial retouching. Preserve realistic skin texture; do not smooth the face excessively.

Camera style: tight 85mm portrait lens, eye-level camera with a very subtle low-angle feel, f/2.0, shallow depth of field, ISO 100, studio-quality sharpness, cinematic high dynamic range.

Mood and style: mysterious, powerful, luxurious, dark editorial fashion photography, cinematic black-and-gold fine-art portrait.

Avoid: colorful lighting outside the eye band, broad sunlight across the full face, glowing or fantasy eyes, harsh face paint effect, overexposed gold highlights, flat lighting, visible background details, soft blurry eyes, artificial skin smoothing, exaggerated expression, smile, accessories, glasses, hats, jewelry, text, watermark, logo, cartoon, CGI, illustration, painting, lens distortion, low-resolution details.

prompts.title: Saturated
prompts.prompt:
Create a striking, high-contrast, close-up black-and-white portrait using the uploaded image as the primary facial reference.
Face Accuracy (Critical)

Match the face with 100% identity accuracy. Preserve exact facial structure, bone anatomy, jawline, cheekbones, forehead proportions, eyebrow thickness and shape, eye size and spacing, nose structure, lip shape, chin contour, and natural skin texture. Maintain natural asymmetry and authentic pores. Do not beautify, stylize, or alter proportions. Remove all accessories. The subject must remain clearly recognizable.
Framing & Composition

Vertical 2:3 aspect ratio.

Extreme close-up framed from slightly above the forehead to just below the chin.

Only the left half of the face is illuminated and fully visible; the right half disappears into deep obsidian shadow.

Eye positioned near the upper-right rule-of-thirds intersection.

Subject fills approximately 70–75% of the frame with negative space on the shadow side.

Background pure black, seamless, textureless.

Mood intimate, intense, claustrophobic.
Expression & Gaze

Solemn, piercing expression.

Direct eye contact.

Head straight, no tilt.

Lips slightly parted.

Emotion neutral but haunting.
Water & Skin Detail

Face covered in abundant water droplets — mix of fine mist and larger spherical beads.

Physically accurate droplets with strong specular highlights, some merging into micro-streaks.

Moist reflective sheen across skin.

Ultra-detailed pores, natural grain, crisp eyebrow texture.

Fine moisture on lips.

Catchlight sharp in iris; eye in perfect focus.
Lighting (Chiaroscuro – Critical)

Single directional light from camera-right, angled slightly downward.

No fill, no rim light.

Strong shadow falloff into pure black.

Deep crushed blacks with bright specular highlights on droplets.

Sculptural three-dimensional modeling of facial planes.
Optics & Quality

85mm–100mm macro portrait lens equivalent.

Shallow depth of field (f/2–f/2.8 feel).

Eye and nearby droplets razor sharp; ear softly fading.

Pure monochrome greyscale with full tonal range.

Ultra-realistic 8K studio photography, high micro-contrast, very subtle fine film grain, no digital artifacts.

prompts.title: Golden Iris
prompts.prompt:
Reference & Identity (STRICT)

Use the uploaded image as a strict facial identity reference.

The subject’s face must remain 100% identical to the reference.
Preserve exactly:

Facial structure, bone anatomy, jawline, cheekbones
Eye shape, spacing, eyelids, gaze
Nose bridge, nostrils, lips, mouth shape
Beard/mustache density and pattern (if present)
Skin tone, undertone, pores, scars, micro-details
Hairline, hairstyle, density
❌ No beautification

❌ No stylization

❌ No face reshaping

❌ No identity drift
🎬 MAIN CONCEPT
Create a striking, high-contrast, extreme close-up (ECU) portrait that blends gritty realism with cinematic stylization.

The image must feel raw, intense, dramatic, and emotionally charged.
The mood should evoke:
endurance, struggle, focus, apex-predator energy.
📐 COMPOSITION & FRAMING
Shot Type: Extreme Close-Up (ECU)
Framing:

The frame is filled entirely by the central facial features:
Bridge of the nose
One visible eye (viewer’s left)
Mouth and upper lip
Perspective: Eye-level, confrontational
Symmetry:

Slightly asymmetrical — wet strands of hair cut across the face, obscuring the opposite eye for mystery and chaos.
💡 LIGHTING & COLOR PROFILE
Color Style: Selective desaturation
Entire image in deep grayscale
Only the visible iris remains in glowing amber / burnt orange
Lighting:

High-contrast directional light from the top-right
Creates deep chiaroscuro shadows
Strong sculpting across the nose bridge and orbital bone
Highlights:

Specular reflections on water droplets and skin, giving a wet metallic sheen
🔬 TEXTURE & MICRO DETAIL
Skin:

Extreme micro-contrast — pores, fine lines, follicles clearly visible

Covered in water droplets of different sizes, refracting light
Eye:

Ultra-detailed iris with radial patterns and Fuchs’ crypts

Subtle sclera veins visible
Hair:

Wet, dark strands — thick, sharp, obsidian-like
Beard / Mustache:

Coarse, individual bristles, sharply defined
🎨 POST-PROCESSING STYLE
Heavy clarity / structure enhancement
Hyper-real texture, tactile realism
Sharp cinematic contrast
No blur, no softness, no glow haze
🏷 TYPOGRAPHY & BRANDING
Bottom-left watermark:
Primary:

PromptPlum.com (clean sans-serif)
Secondary (small, stylized):

All prompts are freely available
🧠 AESTHETIC SUMMARY
A gritty cinematic apex portrait — raw, intense, powerful.

Monochrome world + glowing amber eye = supernatural dominance.
⚠️ Negative Prompt
Low resolution, blur, smooth skin, plastic texture, beauty filter, soft lighting, flat lighting, color bleeding, extra eyes, distorted face, wrong identity, cartoon, anime, oil painting, over-stylization, fantasy skin.
